### Observed differences

- Activity A01 occurred in about 46% of traces before (mean 0.92 per trace) and is absent in the later window. Activity A13 was absent before and occurs in about 53% of traces after (mean 1.105 per trace). [OCC001, OCC002]
- A10's outgoing transition was always to A01 before (184 observed transitions) and always to A13 after (221 observed transitions). [DIR002]
- A01's outgoing transition to A03 disappeared; A13's outgoing transition to A03 appeared. [DIR001, DIR003]
- A01 and A03 co-occurred in 46% of traces before; in the later window A03 occurs alone in all traces. [REL001]
- A01 and A10 co-occurred in 46% of traces before; in the later window A10 occurs alone in 53% of traces. [REL002]
- A01 and A13 never co-occurred; before A01 alone in 46% of traces, after A13 alone in 53% of traces. [REL003]
- A03 and A13: before A03 alone in all traces, after they co-occur in 53% of traces (interleaved or repeated). [REL004]
- A10 and A13: before A10 alone in 46% of traces, after they co-occur in 53% of traces (A10 before A13 in 22.5%, interleaved in 30.5%). [REL005]
- A01's mean position was about 0.68 of the trace before; A13's mean position is about 0.68 after. [POS001, POS002]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports that activity A01 was replaced by activity A13 in the process. A10 now leads to A13 instead of A01, and A03 now co-occurs with A13 instead of A01. The new activity appears at the same relative position as the old one. The consistency across occurrence, successor, relation and position indicators, together with 12 evidence items against 0.16 expected by chance, rules out a sampling artefact. A competing explanation of a rare variant is not credible given the magnitude and coherence of the changes. Other differences: none beyond the replacement.
